method: Read AGENTS.md first. Read all 46 deploy Python and shell source files in full, all 12 scripts in full, all 9 tests/tooling files in full including fixtures, asserted failures and platform skip semantics, and all 11 listed CI/configuration/shared-fixture files in full. HTTPS source output initially truncated in its middle was recovered with an explicit line-range read. Semantic review followed ACME and provided/internal TLS activation, trust retention, origin migration/recovery, service state/enablement, stop-confirmed rollback, initialization identity and filesystem publication, immutable provider generations, native UID and workspace/Git boundaries, source audit/full-test gates, affected selection and cross-platform reconciliation. No application source changed; no tests, online instances, network calls, credentials, old implementation code or Git history were accessed. The generated lock and remaining documents/evidence/deployment tests are not claimed as read. Current full source digest was recomputed with scripts/snapshot.mjs; filename/hash verification is provenance only, not semantic coverage. Parent explicitly narrowed this reviewer closeout to the fully inspected production/tooling/configuration scope and transferred every remaining deployment test, document and generated-evidence/lock file to subsequent independent reviewers. ARCHITECTURE.md was subsequently read in full to assess the worktree archival contract. complete:true refers only to these 79 declared inspected files, not the original 158-file assignment or the full repository. The precise 79-file transferred remainder is saved separately.
